scope: Native operation counts, RR(y) multivariate arithmetic, exact rational-root coverage certificates, simplified characteristic polynomial eigenvector multiplicities, held polynomial conversion and checked exponent storage, Poisson moments and rational simplex pivots

source_identity.scope: Code, tests, audit fixtures, package configuration and native binary; documentation excluded

rust.clippy_1_99_status: Seven preexisting approximate-constant lints fail; portable bit-identical definitions are being corrected in the following batch. No suppression added.

differential_source_conversion.phase: debug candidate before integration of arithmetic guards; source converter unchanged in the release

remaining_gaps: No global algorithmic parity certification; the full documentation-example audit and standalone ODE/integration corpora still need replay.
Operation-count host/container/matrix fallbacks remain Python; composed Idx metadata remains an older gap.
The rational-root coverage shortcut declines unsupported or incomplete proofs; existing solve dict/set ordering and imaginary-variable check=False gaps remain.
Partial substitution of y=0 followed by a=-oo in exp(exp(x)+a)=y remains an old strict xfail.

The exponent guard is scoped, not universal. Total-degree u32 metadata, public contains/reduced boundaries, and dense huge CC/EX storage remain for subsequent fixes; low-level infallible Rust callers require checked boundaries.
Public gigantic Groebner preprocessing is not certified within a bounded time; sparse kernels are checked. Composite modular polynomials still use the old dense Python representation.
QQ_I coefficient storage overflow retains an established exact EX fallback; unsupported storage must never be read as zero or no solutions.
Simplex uses native exact stock QQ pivots; other scalar domains retain the general algorithm. Public bounds transformation and symbolic extraction remain Python.
Poisson stock-model acceleration keeps callback/table/host/dependence guards; general conditional and dependent probability computations remain work to port.
Affine sec/csc and rational-frequency extensions are in a separate validated private patch and are not in this release.
